proposal.reason: Main change adds new MPI unit tests that validate communicator lifecycle semantics (pcclCommGetUniqueId, Grow, Revoke, Shrink interaction, parent destruction, blocking/nonblocking and share settings), which needs communicator-lifecycle review. It also substantively updates CI test orchestration by adding new native test binaries and a new xtest family/case counts to daily/full/smoke workflows, platform definitions, and generation checks, requiring ci review.
